profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Neon
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Studied Business and Data Science at Minerva University and have work experience in fast-paced startups and well-established corporations in multiple countries. I like to build stuff that scales and impacts people positively and love to solve challenges regardless of where they are located in the stack. I like to learn new technologies and languages, just as much as to play football and hiking. 
https://luis-resume.vercel.app/

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description:
Neon is a modern payments and merchant-of-record platform that enables game studios to sell directly to their players. We focus on transparency, partnership, and developer-centric tooling that replaces legacy, black-box systems.

- Working all over the stack. Greenlighting new features and offerings at Neon, like Subscriptions for game studios, dev tools to edit product offerings for games, adding new payment service providers etc...
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Software Design · FinTech · TypeScript · SQL · Node.js · React · Web Architecture · Software Systems Engineering · Software Development

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
KabCash is a FinTech aiming to democratise financial services for Latin America. It offers an easy-to-use mobile platform giving access to one-time-use secure credit and debit cards. We are also integrated with financial institutions and convenience stores to help users digitalise their finances and improve financial inclusion.

● Joined team with goal for high growth. Six months after joinining, registered users getting credit cards has grown by 96x.

● Currently leading development for all new product features and took charge of multiple full product refactorings. (e.g.  refactored app to use Tailwind for more straightfoward and reliable CSS code, upgraded all app packages and our code base to Expo 48 which improved app load time by 45%, refactored code for all push notifications on the app, made app PCI compliant etc..). Refactored the whole navigation system that we were using.

● Mainly using React Native and Typescript for developing our platform for both IOS and Android. Also created the companies website using Astro.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Redux.js · React Native · Full-Stack Development · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · React.js · Data Analysis · Front-End Development

positions.title: (Co-Founder) Software Engineer
positions.description:
Kadi Clubs is a startup focused on creating a better sports club management experience (bookings, payments, analytics, etc.... ). An Airbnb for sport-related experiences.

● Part of the founding Team. Took Kadi from Ideation, Prototyping with user feedback to a live Platform.

● Full Stack Development using React, NextJS, Firebase, Vercel. Implemented Stripe for payment processing, and membership managment and got the company to be profitable within two months of operations.

● Over 20,000+ bookings and 150,000+ USD have been processed on the platform.

● 120 Clubs currently listed mainly in Mexico City, Puebla and Cuernavaca.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · Responsive Web Design · TypeScript · Next.js · Git · Machine Learning · React Native · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Cloud Computing · Firebase · Software Development · Project Management · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
● Was invited to join a team of econometric and data researchers from MIT, Harvard and other universities to use alternative data for investment signaling for hedge funds.

● Worked with a remote team on scraping, cleaning, and productizing data from the IRS, the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), and the stock market.

● Created mathematical models in R to predict market growths for investment firms on a AWS’s EC2 Instances.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Machine Learning · R (Programming Language) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Cloud Computing · Python · Big Data

positions.title: Analytics Engineer
positions.description:
Unilever is a British-Dutch multinational consumer goods company with over 400+ brands across the globe.

● Applied SEO Optimization to get the "Compre Ahora" website highly ranked on Google.

● Used Google Analytics to analyze customer behavior and Magento for sales analytics

● Final Result was an increase from 200 to 25,000 users daily.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · Cloud Computing · Python · Software Development · Project Management · Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Racemappr is a German mobile application focused in helping users book and find competitive races around the world.

● Designed and Prototyped new app features implemented on the web-app. 

● Used Adobe Creative Cloud to iteratively prototype and get user feedback with 40+ interviews.
positions.insights: Skills: User Experience (UX) · Software Development · Adobe XD

positions.title: Founding Software Engineer
positions.description:
The project started in Hitomedia's internship. dBay was the first ever marketplace for NFTs.  https://web.archive.org/web/20190908005310/http://www.dbay.ai/ (Project was sold - Only available via web Archive)

● Designed and created a decentralized marketplace for non-fungible tokens leveraging my front-end skills using React. I also created Solidity based Smart contracts to purchase ERC721 tokens.  

● Tasked with developing the business plan of the platform before Hitomedia Inc compleatly acquiring the company.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · TypeScript · Next.js · Git · Cryptocurrency · Smart Contracts · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Cloud Computing · Ethereum · Software Development · Blockchain · Project Management

positions.title: Technical Project Manager Intern
positions.description:
●	Was the project lead for a Minerva and Kakao short term project with the mission to use Blockchain to incentivize individuals to buy kakao products inside of Kakao Talk.

●	Designed a prototype front-end mobile application, based on analysis from customer data. The mock utilized gamification to motivate users, nudging through peer motivation and would record all the transactions on a closed source blockchain. The goal was to make users pick healthy habits (e.g. running more, swimming, reading etc..)
positions.insights: Skills: Git · UX Research · User Experience (UX) · Blockchain · Project Management

honors.title: CEMEX Mexico Hackathon 2019
honors.description: Created a website to help Cemex track the status of their invoices using Blockchain technology to store all the information of the invoices and thus create an immutable record.

honors.title: MIT BItcoin Hackathon
honors.description: Participated and created a Cryptocurrency Trading Bot that used differences in market prices to find profitable arbitrages. I was the youngest participant.
honors.issuer: Issued by Massachusetts Institute of Technology · Oct 2018

volunteerExperiences.description:
●   From 2014 to 2016 I volunteered for the Non-Profit Organization, Greenpeace Mexico in Monterrey. 

●   During my work as a volunteer, I was in involved in the relations between the groups of Greenpeace in the state of Nuevo Leon and the government.

● Co-founded Minerva’s first blockchain and distributed systems club with over 165+ students involved.

●  We created events in SF with leading experts in the field coming from companies like Coinbase and the Ethereum Foundation.
